name: fastfood-management-system
description: FastFood Management System & Admin Dashboard (Node.js/Express/MongoDB & React/Vite/TypeScript)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
